package rulefixtures

import (
	"html/template"
)

// scenario for go_perf_layer_lazy_loading_eager_template_parse_for_unused_routes: Layer: Lazy loading. Flag parsing templates for routes that may never be served in the current process mode.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
var parsedTemplates = map[string]*template.Template{}

func scenario557Positive() error {
	// All templates are parsed at startup, including ones for routes
	// that are disabled or unused in the current deployment mode.
	// This adds unnecessary startup time and memory overhead.
	routes := []string{"home", "about", "admin", "reports", "settings", "api_docs"}
	for _, route := range routes {
		tmpl, err := template.ParseFiles("templates/" + route + ".html")
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		parsedTemplates[route] = tmpl
	}
	return nil
}
